title: Cooks hot
text:
Cooks hot. While some bad reviews have said it doesn't cook very hot or takes a very long time to reach a hot temperature, we've had the opposite experience. It cooks extremely hot, and the low setting makes soups boil. The outside of the crock pot gets so hot you can't touch it or risk really burning yourself (I say this because I saw a question & answer up above about it not getting too hot on the outside). It's a safety hazard for how hot it cooks!

1/9/2014: On the off chance that it was simply operator error ruining our dinners (like accidentally putting it on high where low should have been used instead), I gave it one last chance to pay extra attention. I had a 3-pound roast ready to go and put it on for four hours on LOW while I finished my day at work (which, theoretically, should take 8-9 to cook; 7 hours at the least). It was overcooked so badly by the time we got home that it's hard as a rock. You have to cut it harder than you do any overcooked steak. It must run so hot that it probably cooked the roast in an hour or hour and a half, tops. What's the point? I might as well cook my meat in the oven instead of trying to be efficient while at work. I'm getting rid of this piece of garbage. I've had enough of costly ruined dinners thanks to this thing.

description: This Crock-Pot 4-Quart Manual Slow Cooker provides you the flexibility to prepare a meal early and then have it slow-cook all day, so you can come home to a nutritious, home-cooked meal in the evening. It's a healthy, cost-efficient, and convenient way to cook. This Crock-Pot Manual Slow Cooker cooks on High or Low settings, and the Warm setting can be used to keep your dish at an ideal serving temperature.
